question.problem:
Which of the following matrices are transformed into the $2\times 2$ identity matrix after applying the row operations ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1}\,$ and $\,{R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
Let's apply the operations to each of the matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ -5 & -24\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-5 & -24 \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne I\,\times  \\ B & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =I\,✓ \\ C & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ 1 & -24\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -24 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne I\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "$B$ only".
